question: The Contingency Fund of India is operated by the _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**President**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The C**ontingency Fund of India is operated by the Finance Secretary on behalf of the President of India**.
 
• The Finance Secretary **is a member of the Department of Economic Affairs.**
 
• The **Contingency Fund of India **is a fund set aside to deal with emergencies and unforeseen expenditures. 
 
• The fund** is established under Article 267 (1) of the Constitution.** 
 
• The Contingency Fund of India Act, 1950 added the fund to the Indian Constitution. 
 
• The President can make advances from the fund to meet urgent expenses, but Parliament must authorize the expenditure. 
 
• The** government cannot withdraw funds from the fund without Parliament's approval. **​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other funds of the Indian government are

 
 
• Consolidated Fund of India
 
 
• **The main fund of the Central Government**
 
• **Includes all government revenues, such as taxes, fees, and loans**
 
• **Used to pay for routine expenses, such as salaries, pensions, and infrastructure projects**
 
• **Requires parliamentary approval for any withdrawals**
 
• **The Comptroller and Auditor General of India audits the fund**
 
 
 
• **Public Accounts of India**
 
 
• **​**Includes all public money received by the government that isn't credited to the Consolidated Fund 
 
• **Includes fund s for national defense, national savings, and disaster management **
